arguments.sql_query:
WITH ult_drugs AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'allopurinol' AS index_drug
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1167322
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, 'febuxostat' AS index_drug
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 19017742
), ult_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, ud.index_drug, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, CASE WHEN ud.index_drug='allopurinol' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS rn
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN ult_drugs ud ON ud.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
), index_ult AS (
    SELECT person_id, index_drug, index_date
    FROM ult_exposures
    WHERE rn = 1
), gout_dx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 440674
), eligible AS (
    SELECT i.person_id, i.index_drug, i.index_date
    FROM index_ult i
    JOIN gout_dx g ON g.person_id = i.person_id
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id
       AND op.observation_period_start_date <= i.index_date
       AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 365, i.index_date)
), flare_codes AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (36674930, 74892)
    UNION SELECT 36674930 UNION SELECT 74892
), flares AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id
    FROM eligible e
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = e.person_id
    JOIN flare_codes fc ON fc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_start_date > e.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, e.index_date)
), urate_labs AS (
    SELECT e.person_id, e.index_drug, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.person_id ORDER BY m.measurement_date DESC, m.measurement_id DESC) AS rn
    FROM eligible e
    JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = e.person_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3037556, 3026493, 4165617, 4194293, 4156643)
      AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
      AND m.measurement_date > e.index_date
      AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, e.index_date)
), last_urate AS (
    SELECT person_id, index_drug, value_as_number
    FROM urate_labs
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT e.index_drug,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_with_flare_code_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_with_flare_code_12mo,
       COUNT(lu.person_id) AS n_with_urate_lab_12mo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN lu.value_as_number < 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_urate_lt6_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN lu.value_as_number < 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(lu.person_id),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_urate_lt6_among_tested,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN lu.value_as_number < 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_urate_lt6_all_patients
FROM eligible e
LEFT JOIN flares f ON f.person_id = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN last_urate lu ON lu.person_id = e.person_id
GROUP BY e.index_drug
ORDER BY e.index_drug;

If counting uric-acid control over the full treated cohort rather than only those tested, UA <6 mg/dL was 11.01% for allopurinol and 14.43% for febuxostat.
